title: Recreation Complex Storage Building Rebid, Project #R27-03

onscreen_lines.desc: Lump Sum Base Bid - Material Storage Building
onscreen_lines.note: Includes construction of a non-conditioned dry material storage building on the previously completed Phase 1 foundation and floor slab. Scope includes CMU veneer walls and piers; masonry reinforcement, dowels, sealant, caps, and water-repellent treatment; roof trusses, wood framing, fascia, cedar soffits, and standing-seam metal roofing; gutters and downspouts; insulated steel overhead doors; insulated hollow-metal personnel door and frame with hardware; steel bollards; structural steel at the required opening; and all related accessories and work required for a complete installation. The Phase 1 footings and slab are existing and are not included in the base-bid construction scope except as necessary for connections to the existing work. A1.0 and A1.1 Architectural Sheet + Special Provisions
